title: Spiced Green Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry made with green vegetables, cardamom, and a hint of spices.

ingredients.name: green vegetables (such as broccoli or green beans)

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cardamom pods and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the green vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the spices and salt, and stir-fry for an additional minute.
If using soy sauce or tamari, add it to the pan and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green herbs if desired.
